notes.title: Evil Bunneh | Up to 75% Sale on All Titles
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38376873/802ef0ad00df7a0a96b21277de2a99329abf7933.png[/img]

Take advantage of our special promotion on all titles of up to 75% off sale today!

[h1]Girls, Guns and Zombies[/h1]
Girls Guns & Zombies is exactly that, girls with guns shooting zombies. While, having some poolside fun in between. Scavenge the ruined city overrun by the undead, collect resources and throw a party for the girls!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1580480/Girls_Guns_and_Zombies/


[h1]Urban Justice[/h1]
Urban Justice is a side scroller fighting game inspired by the genre's classics like Final Fight and Streets of Rage. The game offers a fast paced, casual gameplay that puts players in Riverden, a city being torn apart by gangs, hooligans and corrupted government.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1006150/Urban_Justice


[h1]Desolation: End of Days[/h1]
Desolation - End of Days is a side scroller fighting game. The game offers a fast paced, casual gameplay that puts players in a post-apocalyptic world where infection turned most of the population into a flesh craving monsters.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1454110/Desolation__End_of_Days/


[h1]Medieval: Embers of War[/h1]
Medieval - Embers of War is a side scroller fighting game. The game offers a fast paced, casual gameplay that puts players in a fantasy world where the land is being torn apart by conflict. Players will take on adventures, epic rivals and control of their own castle.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1171070/Medieval__Embers_of_War/


[h1]Frontier - TRS[/h1]
Frontier – Tactical Response Squad is a fast-paced top down shooter based in a dystopian future where mage corporations are in control. The corporations driven the environment to the edge with excessive resource extraction and humanity is forced to live in a high-tech bio domes.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1217480/Frontier__TRS/

notes.title: GGnZ Release is Here!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

We at Evil Bunneh are very happy and excited to announce that Girls, Guns and Zombies is now available!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40143385/d5ebc3209ea2839b851418d0dfdfafa4970f165e.png[/img]

[b]Take advantage of 15% Off release discount![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1580480/Girls_Guns_and_Zombies

Join us in a thrilling, action packed zombie shooter and share your experiences with us, the developers. We are eager to hear your feedback and your ideas of new features and how we can improve the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38376873/9bb32087b449a20a6e1bf27d90a95360dd8f1c7e.png[/img]

Girls Guns & Zombies is exactly that, girls with guns shooting zombies. While, having some poolside fun in between. Scavenge the ruined city overrun by the undead, collect resources and throw a party for the girls!

Features:

• Beautiful, stylized characters
• A city to explore
• Thrilling action gameplay
• Post-apocalyptic setting
• Pool party with girls!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40143385/bd409bb228b8ab76bc8e6f9fff181dfb3b658ced.png[/img]

Thank you!
